name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corp Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd is in the business of fertlisers, agri services, bulk chemicals, mining chemicals and real estate[1]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 18.1%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.5% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 16 Nov - Audio recording of 16 November 2026 earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY2026 results available online.

Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Newspaper Publication 14 Nov - Intimation of newspaper publication for the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 14 Nov - ITAT dismissed department appeals for AY 2013-14 to 2018-19, confirming relief on ₹215 crore dispute.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 13 Nov - Board approved Q2 and H1 FY27 results; consolidated PAT rose 93% to ₹884 crore.
